name: Octopost
summary: Social media manager for eight networks: approvals, week planner, previews and network stats
about: An app for marketing agencies and in-house social teams to plan, approve, post and track content on eight networks for several brands. Write one caption, tweak it per network and check every preview, then move posts through review and onto an hourly week planner. It comes in black and neon for dark mode and a clean light theme, following your system setting.
how: Switch brand workspace from the top button; posts, stats and the library change with it.
In Compose, pick networks, write the main caption, then open a network tab to give it its own text. The preview strip and character limits update as you type.
Publish now to watch sparks fly from the brand hub to each network on the orbit, or schedule it, save a draft or send it for review.
In Week, drag a post to another day and hour, or drag it to Not scheduled yet. Press Enter on a post for keyboard moves.
Approvals is a board from Draft to Scheduled with comments, approve and request-changes buttons.
Stats compares networks with a 7D, 30D and 90D switch; Library, Team and Settings manage media, hashtag sets, roles, permissions and connections.
